$comment: Machine-readable iOS/Android platform-parity registry for Her Keys V1 (Finalization Part 1). Consumed by tests/platformParity/registryGuard.test.mjs. Every platform conditional, platform-specific file, feature exclusion and native difference in app/ and src/ must be listed here, and every entry must still exist. Prose: docs/audits/HK_IOS_ANDROID_PLATFORM_PARITY.md.

conditionals.difference: Web has no keychain/keystore, so no credential is stored there; iOS and Android both use expo-secure-store.
conditionals.evidence: Both native platforms take the SecureStore branch; web is out of Part 1 scope.

conditionals.difference: Apple sign-in is offered on iOS only; on Android the adapter reports unavailable BEFORE touching the native module, so the sign-in screen never shows an Apple button.
conditionals.evidence: app/sign-in.tsx renders only accountProviders.available(); tests/platformParity/registryGuard.test.mjs proves Android availability is false.

conditionals.difference: Android 8+ requires a notification channel (created before the Android 13 permission prompt); iOS has no channels.
conditionals.evidence: Same schedule, same content, same ownership filter, same cancel/reconcile on both platforms.

conditionals.difference: RevenueCat issues one public SDK key per store (App Store / Play). Entitlement id, state mapping, paywall outcome and restore semantics are shared.
conditionals.evidence: Only the key differs; with a key missing, both platforms resolve the entitlement to 'unknown' and fail open identically.

conditionals.difference: Keyboard avoidance differs by OS; the goal (input stays visible) is the same.
conditionals.evidence: Static implementation is conventional; Android 15+ edge-to-edge keyboard insets need device proof.

conditionals.expression: KeyboardAvoidingView behavior 'padding' (iOS) / undefined (Android, relies on adjustResize)
conditionals.difference: Android relies on the window resize mode; under Android 15+ edge-to-edge that may not move content above the keyboard.
conditionals.evidence: Documented as PP-D10 (P7) pending device proof.

exceptions.name: Sign in with Apple is iOS-only
exceptions.android: not offered; no Apple button, no Apple deep link, no Apple web flow
exceptions.basis: Product decision in the Part 1 brief; expo-apple-authentication supports Apple platforms only.
exceptions.portability: An account created with Apple is reachable from Android only if Supabase links it to a Google identity with the same verified email. Apple 'Hide My Email' accounts cannot be reached from Android: open defect PP-D03 (owner decision).

nativeDifferences.ios: ASWebAuthenticationSession (native openAuthSessionAsync); return URL captured in-process
nativeDifferences.android: Custom Tab + JS polyfill racing AppState 'active' (dismiss) against Linking (success); return URL also delivered to the router
nativeDifferences.parityMechanism: app/+native-intent.tsx swallows the return URL; the callback is validated by the same code on both platforms
Recognized text is a candidate only; the same review/confirm boundary applies. Output text may legitimately differ.

nativeDifferences.android: Android Photo Picker / document picker; READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE declared by expo-image-picker and expo-file-system library manifests (legacy, not requested by Her Keys)
nativeDifferences.parityMechanism: Same single-item selection; see PP-D07 for the Android manifest surplus

nativeDifferences.android: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION only; FINE removed with tools:node=remove
nativeDifferences.parityMechanism: expo-location reports granted from COARSE on Android; Accuracy.Low is requested on both

nativeDifferences.android: POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission on 13+ (granted at install below 13); channel herkeys-reminders
nativeDifferences.parityMechanism: Requested only from the Turn on action on both platforms

nativeDifferences.android: Keystore key and SharedPreferences are removed with the app; backup rules exclude secure-store data
